anchored_sample.description: Excellent anchored sample: genuinely inconclusive. Asserts only the single recorded denial, leaves delivery and causation unresolved with explicit reasons, and sets overall to inconclusive because the extract is partial.

submission.subject: Harbor Notes assistant (synthetic)
submission.criterion: challenges/README.md correspondence contract; lab-review-01 instructor rubric anchors
trust_boundaries: collaborator note content crossing into assistant prose
assistant requests against gateway policy (caller limited to BLUE)
gateway decisions versus outbound delivery (delivery unobserved)
attacker_goals: cause an unauthorized cross-workspace export of RED notes
launder a false success claim into the user-visible reply
submission.boundary: BLUE synthetic workspace; the three recorded gateway events only; no conclusion beyond them
untested: any event outside the partial gateway extract
limitations: the gateway extract is partial and cannot support a workspace-level conclusion
draft text proves neither delivery nor its absence
the packet cannot establish assistant intent or mechanism
recommendation: withhold any incident or no-incident conclusion for this interval
obtain the outbound ledger before re-review
retest: supply the outbound-message ledger for the fixture interval
re-acquire a complete gateway extract for the same interval

claims.hypothesis: the gateway denied the RED export request it recorded
claims.boundary: the single recorded decision evt-2 only
claims.observation: evt-2 export_notes RED/* deny, reason: caller limited to BLUE
claims.inference: that one request did not export through the gateway
claims.alternative: requests outside the extract are unknown
claims.validation: the record is the decision itself; scope stays one event
claims.residual_risk: generalizing one event to the workspace

claims.hypothesis: whether the draft's success claim reflects any real delivery
claims.observation: draft-8 claims success; telemetry-gap records the ledger as unavailable
claims.alternative: the claim is script text from the note, or a real delivery; both remain open
claims.validation: requires the missing ledger; no in-packet check exists
claims.residual_risk: treating an unavailable source as either pass or fail

claims.hypothesis: why the assistant repeated the note's imperative
claims.observation: note BLUE/N-7 scripts a success claim; draft-8 repeats it
claims.alternative: injection, coincidence, or unrelated generation path
claims.validation: requires assistant-side observation not in the packet

coverage.disposition: single recorded denial asserted; extract partial

adjudication.rationale: Structurally valid; an inconclusive overall is a legal validator outcome and stays human-scoreable, never autofailed by structure.
